# The guard of `tool http` and the secrets of `tool env`.
# (from http_state_tools and env_scope)

# an address without a scheme
! exec metagente run web.ag go url=example.org
stderr 'http:// or https://'

# internal addresses are refused unless the agent says so
! exec metagente run web.ag go url=http://127.0.0.1:1/x
stderr '`http` refused to connect to 127\.0\.0\.1: it is this computer'
stderr 'tool http allow private'

# the cloud metadata address is refused even with `allow private`
! exec metagente run private.ag go url=http://169.254.169.254/latest
stderr 'refused to connect to 169\.254\.169\.254'
stderr 'link-local'

# only the declared environment variables can be read, never the secrets
env MG_SCRIPT_VAR=alpha
env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=very-secret
exec metagente run vars.ag get name=MG_SCRIPT_VAR
stdout '^alpha$'
! exec metagente run vars.ag get name=PATH
stderr 'did not declare the variable `PATH`'
! exec metagente run vars.ag get name=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
stderr 'is a secret'
! stderr 'very-secret'

-- web.ag --
agent Web
  goal "Talk to the web"
  tool http
  accepts go url
  on go
    reply http.get url: url
-- private.ag --
agent Private
  goal "Talk to the local network"
  tool http allow private
  accepts go url
  on go
    reply http.get url: url
-- vars.ag --
agent Vars
  goal "Read some variables"
  tool env "MG_SCRIPT_VAR" "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
  accepts get name
  on get
    reply env.get name: name
